title: Workshop Liaison Note: Chain and Solder Work Credited Against a Refused Claim
content:
Where a claim is refused on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans that includes chain and solder work without a claim, the workshop's published charge for that work comes off the figure the refusal is recorded at, because the coverage would have answered for the work anyway. The charge is the one the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service publishes for a chain solder at the level the work order carrying the claim's reference runs at.

Where the coverage includes chain and solder work and no settlement entry for a parted chain stands on the plan inside the window over which routine work and goodwill drawn are counted, the workshop's published charge for a chain solder at the level that work order runs at comes off. Where the coverage includes chain and solder work and a settlement entry for a parted chain stands on the plan inside that window, the drawn-service share of that published charge comes off, being 0.5 of it. In any other case nothing at all comes off for work the coverage would have answered for without a claim.

## What comes off in each case

| Chain and solder work included by the coverage | Settlement entries for a parted chain inside the window | What comes off the figure |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | the published charge for a chain solder at the level the work order runs at |
| yes | one or more | 0.5 of that published charge |
| no | any | nothing at all |

## Which plans include chain and solder work

| Plan | Chain and solder repairs included without a claim |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | no |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | yes |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | yes |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | yes |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | yes |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | yes |

## Worked reading

On a plan that includes chain and solder work, where the level the work order runs at publishes a chain solder charge of 58.00 USD and no settlement entry for a parted chain stands inside the window, 58.00 USD comes off the figure the refusal is recorded at; where such a settlement entry does stand inside the window, 29.00 USD comes off.
